query:
SELECT ct.*, u.email, u.name 
FROM credits_transactions ct 
JOIN users u ON ct.userId = u.id 
WHERE ct.type IN ('purchase', 'consume')
ORDER BY ct.createdAt DESC 
LIMIT 20;
